exposure: Type of surgery (orthopedic, abdominal, cesarean section, CABG)
outcome: Minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) of bacteria causing SSI
cohort: 103 patients with surgical site infections after orthopedic, abdominal, cesarean section, or CABG surgery in three referral hospitals in North of Iran
finding: The study found a worrisome increase in the MIC of S. aureus to vancomycin, potentially complicating the treatment of staphylococcal SSIs.
